items.title: Reddit Beat on Revenue, Profit, and Guidance. Its U.S. Daily Users Went Backward, and the Stock Fell 21%.
items.summary: Reddit delivered strong Q2 earnings with 61% revenue growth to $805M and net income nearly tripling to $253M, but U.S. daily active users declined sequentially from 53.5M to 53.2M—the first quarterly decline in five quarters. This user stagnation in the U.S., which generates 79% of revenue at $11.85 per user, triggered a 21% stock decline despite the company trading at 33x earnings.

items.title: Backpack Launches First 24/7 Market for Real U.S. Equities
items.summary: Backpack, a crypto-traditional finance bridge platform, launched 24/7 trading for select U.S. equities including SpaceX, Micron, and SanDisk for international investors. Unlike synthetic derivatives, investors hold real securities with instant settlement and continuous price discovery, available via fiat or stablecoins.
